reason: The plugin improves the workspace picker and session entry flow by provisioning a default local workspace and offering conversations without a workspace.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 自动准备默认本地工作区，并在新会话选择器中提供不绑定工作区的对话选项。
summaries.en: Automatically prepares a default local workspace for DeepSeek Harness and adds an option to start conversations without a workspace.

capabilities: Creates a local default workspace directory
Registers a workspace in the host workspace registry
Adds a no-workspace option to the session picker
Creates sessions without an attached workspace
